newsitem.title: USA: TCI Satellite launches TEMPO satellite.
newsitem.headline: TCI Satellite launches TEMPO satellite.

text.p: TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc said Saturday that its TEMPO direct broadcast satellite was successfully launched in orbit that morning from Cape Canaveral, Fla.

TCI said TEMPO is one of a new generation of high-powered direct broadcast satellites and will occupy the 118.8 Celsius West longitude orbital location, able to provide direct-to-home television service throughout the continental U.S., Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.
The launch had been delayed twice last week due to high winds and technical trouble.
